transitions.fromZh: 圈印已出现，尚未被记录
transitions.fromEn: the ring has appeared but has not been recorded
transitions.toEn: Axi chooses not to count the ring
transitions.narrativeZh: 圈印留在木板上；没有数字替它收束。
transitions.narrativeEn: The ring remains on the boards, without a number to close it.
transitions.npcReactionZh: 海与木板都没有给出新的刻度。
transitions.npcReactionEn: Neither the sea nor the boards provide a new measure.
transitions.atlasHookEn: The ring beside the jar remains open.

transitions.fromEn: the thin ledger is closed, its last page blank
transitions.toZh: 旅人看过末页后仍将薄簿合上
transitions.toEn: the traveler leaves the ledger closed after seeing its last page
transitions.narrativeZh: 空白没有被补写，薄簿回到原处。
transitions.narrativeEn: Nothing is added to the blank page; the ledger returns to its place.
transitions.npcReactionZh: 薄簿轻轻合上，没有留下姓名。
transitions.npcReactionEn: The ledger closes softly, leaving no name behind.
transitions.atlasHookZh: 末页仍空着，不必留下姓名。
transitions.atlasHookEn: The last page stays blank; no name is needed.

transitions.fromEn: the grain of salt rests beside the water jar
transitions.toZh: 旅人选择让盐粒留在原处
transitions.toEn: the traveler leaves the grain of salt where it is
transitions.narrativeZh: 盐粒没有被收起，也没有被带到船边。
transitions.narrativeEn: The grain is neither put away nor carried to the boat.
transitions.npcReactionZh: 水壶移回原处，盐粒仍留在旁边。
transitions.npcReactionEn: The jar returns to its place; the grain remains beside it.
transitions.atlasHookZh: 壶边留着一粒未被收起的盐。
transitions.atlasHookEn: One grain remains beside the jar.

transitions.fromZh: 船底干痕仍在，旅人尚未查看
transitions.fromEn: the dry mark beneath the boat remains, uninspected
transitions.toZh: 旅人不去查看，承认它没有变化
transitions.toEn: the traveler does not inspect it and accepts that it has not changed
transitions.narrativeZh: 船仍停在门外；干痕没有被量取或登记。
transitions.narrativeEn: The boat remains outside; the dry mark is neither measured nor recorded.
transitions.npcReactionEn: The tide comes and goes; the boat does not depart.
transitions.atlasHookZh: 船底干痕仍在，无人量取。
transitions.atlasHookEn: The dry mark beneath the boat remains unmeasured.

atlasDraft.pZh: 清晨，阿汐移开水壶，木板上留着一圈浅印。盐粒没有滚动，印子也没有合拢。薄簿仍合着，船仍停在门外。船底的干痕没有变。她没有数那圈印，也没有把壶移远。
atlasDraft.pEn: At dawn, Axi moved the water jar, leaving a pale ring on the boards. The grain of salt did not roll, and the ring did not close. The ledger stayed shut; the boat remained outside, its dry mark unchanged. She did not count the ring or move the jar away.
atlasDraft.codaZh: 有些线，只在两处之间留下。
atlasDraft.codaEn: Some lines remain only between two places.
